taskName: Stack vs Heap Allocation & Lifetime Drill
conceptTopics: Stack vs Heap allocation in LLD
The this pointer and execution context
rawDesc:
Implement a resource-holding ConnectionPool class demonstrating stack vs heap instantiation and proper destructor cleanup.

### Objective:
1. Stack instantiation vs Heap instantiation with new.
2. Proper lifecycle cleanup in destructor to prevent memory leaks.
3. Preventing copy construction or assignment when a class owns exclusive system handles.

### Acceptance Criteria:
* Class allocates and cleans up its own buffer without leaking.
* Destructor logs destruction sequence proving cleanup upon stack frame exit.

conceptTopics: Value vs Reference semantics (Vehicle& vs Vehicle*)
Const reference passing for read-only efficiency
Dangling pointers and object lifecycle tracking
rawDesc: Given buggy code where a Car holds a raw pointer to an Engine created on the stack that goes out of scope, refactor the code to clearly enforce whether the Car owns the engine (Composition) or borrows it (Aggregation), passing by const reference where mutation is forbidden.

conceptTopics: Base pointer to derived object (Base* b = new Derived())
VTable and VPtr runtime dispatch mechanism
Pure virtual functions and Abstract Classes as strict contracts
Virtual destructors and avoiding incomplete deletion memory leaks
rawDesc: Demonstrate runtime dispatch with a base contract pointer. Implement pure virtual function pay(int amount) = 0. Demonstrate the memory leak caused when the base class destructor is not virtual, then fix it with virtual ~PaymentMethod() = default.

taskName: Defending State Invariants in Shopping Cart
conceptTopics: Domain business methods vs property setters
rawDesc: A ShoppingCart exposes getItems() returning a raw mutable list. External calling code bypasses validation by clearing the list directly or pushing negative price items. Encapsulate all cart mutations behind business methods (addItem, removeItem, applyCoupon) and return unmodifiable collection views.

taskName: Immutable Money Value Object with Invariant Guards
conceptTopics: Immutability for thread safety and side-effect prevention
Financial precision: integer cents vs floating point drift
rawDesc: Build an immutable Money Value Object handling integer cents and ISO currency codes. Enforce validation: cents cannot be negative, currency cannot be empty. Invariant guard: adding Money of different currencies throws a typed CurrencyMismatchException. Implement structural value equality.

Analyze 6 real-world domain pairs: Order <-> OrderItem, Department <-> Professor, Doctor <-> Patient, House <-> Room, Driver <-> Car, PaymentGateway <-> CheckoutController. Write constructor signatures and lifecycle management logic for each.

taskName: Dismantling Fragile Base Class in Notification System
conceptTopics: Class Explosion across multiple variation axes
Predicting inheritance collapse under future requirements
rawDesc: A notification system was modeled with deep inheritance: Notification -> EmailNotification -> EncryptedEmailNotification -> PriorityEncryptedEmailNotification... Refactor the architecture using composition: separate dispatch channel from formatting and priority behaviors so new channels can be added with 1 class instead of 8.

conceptTopics: Class Explosion across multiple variation axes
Predicting inheritance collapse under future requirements
rawDesc: Given a game character hierarchy (Character -> Warrior, Mage, Archer), predict what happens when the game introduces dual-class characters or dynamic weapon-swapping at runtime. Formulate the concrete design pivot needed before writing code.

taskName: Digital Wallet Domain Model & CRC Extraction
conceptTopics: Filtering out primitive attributes vs genuine domain entities
Mapping message passing lifelines with UML Sequence diagrams
rawDesc: Read a 3-paragraph specification for a Peer-to-Peer Digital Wallet. Extract candidate entities (filtering out primitive data and helpers), write CRC cards establishing single responsibility per entity, and trace a sequence diagram for transferFunds().

conceptTopics: Detecting God Class antipatterns and high coupling
Extract Class and Move Method refactoring techniques
Separation of business logic from infrastructure I/O
rawDesc: An 800-line UserManager handles: password hashing, SQL database persistence, email validation, session tokens, and PDF invoice generation. A bug fix in PDF formatting breaks user login. Extract cohesive sub-components: PasswordService, UserRepository, TokenManager, and InvoiceGenerator. Ensure UserService strictly orchestrates business workflows without touching raw I/O.

A CloudStorageProvider interface contains: upload(), download(), transcodeVideo(), generateThumbnail(), and billTenant(). Simple text-storage clients are forced to implement video methods with throw new UnsupportedOperationException(). Segregate into role-tailored interfaces: StorageReader, StorageWriter, and MediaProcessor, refactoring clients to depend only on the minimal interface they require.

taskName: Replacing Type-Code Switch with Polymorphic Strategy
conceptTopics: Smell of type-code switch statements across codebases
Adding new variants with zero modification to tested code
rawDesc: A TaxCalculator contains a 40-line switch(regionCode) statement. Every quarter when new tax jurisdictions are added, tested code must be modified, risking global regression. Extract an abstract TaxComputationStrategy interface and implement a registry map allowing dynamic registration of regional tax calculators without modifying existing classes.

conceptTopics: Classic Square extends Rectangle geometric trap
Preconditions cannot be strengthened, postconditions cannot be weakened
rawDesc: Analyze two classic subtyping traps: Square extends Rectangle where setting width mutates height, and ReadOnlyCollection extends Collection where .add() throws runtime exceptions. Write clean, LSP-compliant refactorings separating mutable from immutable hierarchies.

conceptTopics: High-level policy decoupling from low-level detail
Constructor Dependency Injection without magic frameworks
rawDesc: Build an OrderFulfillmentService that depends on abstract PaymentPort and NotificationPort. Provide production implementations (StripeGateway, SendgridMailer). Write unit tests using FakePaymentPort and FakeNotificationPort asserting behavior without network calls.

conceptTopics: Interface vs Abstract Class usage criteria
rawDesc: Evaluate 8 concrete scenarios and justify whether inheritance or composition provides superior maintainability, testability, and resilience to requirement changes.

taskName: Switch vs Polymorphism: Defining the Threshold
conceptTopics: Interface vs Abstract Class usage criteria
rawDesc: When is a 3-case switch statement completely acceptable, and when does it become an antipattern? Establish the 4-question decision checklist to avoid over-engineering.

taskName: Concrete Class vs Abstract Class vs Interface
conceptTopics: Interface vs Abstract Class usage criteria
rawDesc: Classify when to use pure interfaces (behavioral contracts) vs abstract base classes (shared state and template method hooks).

conceptTopics: Interface vs Abstract Class usage criteria
rawDesc: Take an over-engineered codebase with 6 unnecessary interfaces and 2 factories for a feature that only has 1 implementation, and refactor it to simple, robust code.

taskName: Predicting OCP Failures in Notification Engine
conceptTopics: Interface vs Abstract Class usage criteria
rawDesc: Analyze an existing notification service and predict which future requirements will trigger cascade edits. Formulate the proactive design modification.

conceptTopics: Composition over inheritance in algorithm evolution
rawDesc:
A ShippingRateCalculator has hardcoded rules for FedEx, DHL, and Postal. Adding dynamic holiday discounts and overnight courier calculation causes sprawling conditionals.

### Requirements:
1. Extract an interchangeable ShippingPricingStrategy interface.
2. Implement concrete strategies and configure them dynamically at checkout.
3. Write tests verifying strategy swapping without modifying CheckoutService.

conceptTopics: Loose coupling between subject and observers
rawDesc:
Build an in-memory pub-sub OrderEventManager:
1. When an order is placed, notify InventoryService, EmailService, AnalyticsService, and BillingService.
2. Allow listeners to subscribe/unsubscribe dynamically at runtime.
3. Handle exceptions thrown by one listener without terminating the notification loop.

A publishing platform models a Document with nested `if (status == DRAFT) ... else if (status == REVIEW)`. Invalid transitions happen silently.

### Requirements:
1. Extract a DocumentState interface.
2. Encapsulate state-specific behaviors (edit(), review(), publish(), archive()) in concrete state classes.
3. Throw typed exceptions for illegal transitions (e.g., editing an Archived document).

Build a transactional canvas or text buffer:
1. Encapsulate actions (InsertTextCommand, DeleteTextCommand, FormatCommand) as objects with execute() and undo().
2. Maintain command history stacks supporting arbitrary multi-level Undo and Redo operations.

Construct a web request filter pipeline:
1. Chain handlers: RateLimitHandler -> AuthenticationHandler -> SanitizationHandler -> PayloadValidationHandler.
2. Allow any handler in the chain to abort the request or pass it to next().

taskName: Document Exporter Factory & HTTP Config Builder
conceptTopics: Factory Method intent and creator hierarchy
Builder pattern intent & fluent API construction
rawDesc:
1. Build a DocumentExporterFactory returning PdfExporter, MarkdownExporter, or HtmlExporter.
2. Build an immutable HttpRequestConfig using a fluent Builder enforcing mandatory URL and headers before .build().

taskName: Dynamic Beverage Addons & Legacy Payment Bridge
conceptTopics: Dynamic runtime behavior augmentation without subclass explosion
Wrapping legacy or external vendor SDKs
rawDesc:
1. Build a dynamic beverage ordering system where toppings (Milk, Syrup, WhipCream) wrap Beverage instances dynamically at runtime.
2. Build an ExternalStripeAdapter wrapping a legacy third-party vendor SDK into our domain's PaymentProcessor interface.

conceptTopics: Uniform treatment of leaves and composites
rawDesc:
Build an in-memory FileSystem modeling File and Directory:
1. Both implement FileSystemNode exposing getSize(), printTree(), delete().
2. A directory computes its size by recursively summing all child files and subdirectories uniformly.

taskName: Proxy, Facade & Template Method Implementation Drill
conceptTopics: Proxy pattern: Caching, virtual, and protection proxies
Facade pattern: High-level unified subsystem interface
Template Method: Invariant algorithm skeleton with hooks
Mediator vs Observer: Centralized vs distributed communication
rawDesc:
1. Implement a caching Image Proxy and a high-level Video Converter Facade.
2. Build an algorithmic skeleton using Template Method with hook steps.
3. Compare Mediator vs Observer: Centralized hub vs distributed pub-sub.

conceptTopics: Double-Checked Locking and Bill Pugh idioms
Global state issues and testing bottlenecks
rawDesc:
A global mutable ConfigurationManager.getInstance() creates hidden dependencies, prevents unit testing parallelism, and breaks thread safety.

### Requirements:
1. Implement thread-safe Double-Checked Locking and Bill Pugh Singleton.
2. Refactor callers to receive dependencies via constructor injection instead of calling .getInstance().

conceptTopics: Flyweight pattern: Intrinsic vs extrinsic state sharing
Memento pattern: Snapshotting state without violating encapsulation
Visitor pattern: Adding operations across node hierarchies
rawDesc:
1. Flyweight: Sharing immutable font/character glyph state in a text rendering engine.
2. Memento: Capturing private snapshot of game state without breaking encapsulation.
3. Visitor: Adding XML and JSON export operations across an AST node hierarchy without editing node classes.

Client awareness vs state-driven automatic transitions
Class diagram comparison and discriminator tests
rawDesc: Both Strategy and State delegate to an interface. Formulate the concrete mental test that determines whether you are solving an interchangeable algorithm problem or a state-driven behavior problem.

taskName: Decorator vs Adapter vs Proxy Decision Drill

Proxy: controlling access with same interface
rawDesc:
All three wrap an object. Compare their intents:
* Adapter changes the interface.
* Decorator augments behavior while keeping the same interface.
* Proxy controls access while keeping the same interface.

conceptTopics: Recognizing friction points in evolving codebases
Predicting pattern selection from user stories
rawDesc:
Given an e-commerce checkout handling coupon codes, order totals, and fulfillment.
Predict which patterns emerge when the business adds: dynamic gift wrapping, multiple payment providers, and external webhook broadcasting.

Build a thread-safe in-memory BoundedQueue without using built-in concurrent collections:
1. Implement enqueue() and dequeue() using explicit mutex locks and condition variables.
2. Ensure threads block safely when queue is full or empty.

taskName: Expiring Lock Manager with Compensating Release
rawDesc:
Build an ExpiringLockManager managing temporary reservations (e.g. cinema seats or hotel rooms):
1. User locks a resource with a 10-minute TTL.
2. A background timer releases expired locks if payment is not confirmed.
3. Write unit tests demonstrating that expired locks become available to competing threads immediately.

1. Formulate the 5 essential scoping questions (functional vs non-functional boundaries).
2. Clarify scale, concurrency, and persistence assumptions.
3. Explicitly agree on the top 3 use cases to code with the interviewer.
